query: how many episodes of pride and prejudice netflix
title: How many episodes of Pride and Prejudice on Netflix? Six, all Dec. 3
answer: Netflix's Pride and Prejudice has six episodes, and all six arrive at once on Dec. 3, 2026. The limited series, written by Dolly Alderton and directed by Euros Lyn, stars Emma Corrin as Elizabeth Bennet and Jack Lowden as Mr. Darcy.
body:
The new Pride and Prejudice is a six-part limited series adapted from Jane Austen's 1813 novel. It was made by Lookout Point, a BBC Studios company, for Netflix. Dolly Alderton, the author of Everything I Know About Love, wrote the scripts and serves as showrunner, and Euros Lyn directed all six episodes. Netflix announced the project in April 2025 and set the Dec. 3 release date in September 2026.

The cast is led by Emma Corrin (The Crown) as Elizabeth Bennet and Jack Lowden (Slow Horses) as Fitzwilliam Darcy. Olivia Colman plays Mrs. Bennet and Rufus Sewell plays Mr. Bennet, with Freya Mavor as Jane, Rhea Norwood as Lydia, Hopey Parish as Mary and Hollie Avery as Kitty. Daryl McCormack plays Mr. Bingley, Siena Kelly is Caroline Bingley, Louis Partridge is Mr. Wickham, Jamie Demetriou is Mr. Collins, Jasmine Blackborow is Charlotte Lucas and Fiona Shaw is Lady Catherine de Bourgh.

Filming began in July 2025 in England, including the Peak District in Derbyshire, Spitalfields in East London and the town of Rye in East Sussex, which stands in for Meryton. Promotional material describes it as a faithful period adaptation rather than a modern retelling. It follows two famous versions: the 2005 film with Keira Knightley and the BBC's 1995 series with Colin Firth, which also ran six episodes.
in_the_news: Netflix releases all six episodes of Pride and Prejudice on Thursday, Dec. 3, 2026.

faq.q: When does Pride and Prejudice come out on Netflix?
faq.a: Thursday, Dec. 3, 2026, with all six episodes released at once.

faq.q: Who plays Mr. Darcy in Netflix's Pride and Prejudice?
faq.a: Jack Lowden. Emma Corrin plays Elizabeth Bennet.

faq.q: Is Netflix's Pride and Prejudice a movie or a series?
faq.a: A six-episode limited series, not a film.

faq.q: Where was Netflix's Pride and Prejudice filmed?
faq.a: In England, including the Peak District, Spitalfields in London and Rye in East Sussex.
